artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: ReportValidator routes a document with a provider member to AnalysisReport.v2.schema.json (the package _contracts/ copy unless the schema directory holds one) and refuses an OPAL_ENGINE document carrying a vendor member; a document with no provider stays on v1.

metadata_kind tells the vendor key set from the Opal key set and refuses both on one request; _publish_opal persists an OPAL_ENGINE document with a retained PDF of family OPAL_REPORT_PDF; the vendor branch is untouched.
checkpoint_pdf and finish accept either key set (never both), the Opal one from RECEIVED/CLAIMED/CERTIFYING, so an Opal job goes RECEIVED -> CERTIFYING -> READY.
Opal assembly, opal_engine_publication_ready, an invalid-publication matrix, v1_publication_unchanged, v1_document_persists_byte_equal (digest pinned from the publisher at HEAD, proven there)
Opal worker path to READY and mixed_key_sets_refused

mutant.description: The negative arms run inside the tests: a vendor member on an OPAL_ENGINE document, a wrong Opal sha256, a vendor-family PDF under the Opal key set, a census on an Opal request, an invalid section status, a wrong revision, a vendor-state job, a missing vendor_artifact on the v1 path, an Opal member on the v1 path, the Opal PDF family on the v1 path, and key sets mixed at the top level and inside effective_inputs.
mutant.expected: each raises a refusal and persists nothing (no Dynamo transaction, no S3 put)
mutant.observed: the tests pass, so every negative arm raised

determinism.method: each criterion run once; the v1 byte-equal digest was read on 3 separate runs and its one varying member (the specimen PDF's own sha256, which carries a creation stamp) is fixed before pinning; the unchanged HEAD publisher was run against the same test and passed
determinism.observed: stable digest 3ceb223e... over 3 runs; HEAD publisher (md5 equal to git HEAD) passes the byte-equal test

declared_exclusions.item: Any vendor call, AWS call, S3 or DynamoDB write, deploy, registry row or grant; the repository's real policy registration of OPAL_REPORT_PDF; the resident worker's READY reopen for an Opal report; a document larger than the 32 KiB checkpoint
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden or outside the order's paths; filed as rows IRPT_YCDGEN-W3-S8, S9 and S11.
